name: send_sound_command
purpose: Submit a sound command with a direct response destination and byte count
arguments: command word; response destination pointer; response byte count word
return: D0.l = 1 when accepted, 0 when latch or direct-response channel is busy
exceptional_convention: normal stack wrapper over 0x4198 register body

name: send_sound_command_register
purpose: Submit the packed command/direct-response request already loaded in registers
arguments: D0.l = response count in high word and command in low word; A0 = response destination; A1 = sound state base
exceptional_convention: register entry shared with the 0x4184 wrapper

name: send_sound_command_wait
purpose: Wait until the sound latch is available and submit one command
exceptional_convention: normal stack veneer; D0=0 selects retry in shared body 0x41CE

name: try_send_sound_command
purpose: Attempt one sound-latch submission without waiting
exceptional_convention: normal stack veneer; D0=1 selects one attempt in shared body 0x41CE

name: process_sound
purpose: Advance sound-status polling, coin-status delivery, EEPROM processing, and command-3 response polling

name: sound_receive_irq_body
purpose: Receive one sound byte into the active direct destination or the 15-byte ring
exceptional_convention: interrupt entry; saves D0/A0/A1 and returns with RTE

name: read_sound_data
purpose: Pop one byte from the 15-byte sound receive ring
return: D0.l = next byte, or -1 when empty

name: reset_sound_cpu
purpose: Assert sound reset, emit a startup command, clear queue/direct-response state, and release reset
arguments: sound control word; startup command word
